Ophthotech Corporation, a biopharmaceutical company, develops novel therapeutics to treat diseases of the back of the eye. The company has market cap of $97.35 million. The Company’s principal product candidate, Fovista, an anti-platelet derived growth factor, is in Phase III clinical development for use in combination with anti-vascular endothelial growth factor drugs for the treatment of wet age-related macular degeneration . It has a 0.67 P/E ratio. The firm is also developing Zimura, an inhibitor of complement factor C5, for the treatment of dry AMD and wet AMD.
